editorial.blurb: Frida Room Pilsen is a warmly decorated, welcoming spot in Pilsen serving excellent Mexican-inspired brunch and café favorites at very reasonable prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for Maria (la Chiquita) when you arrive—she's known for exceptional, attentive service. Go early on weekdays to avoid the crowds, and definitely order the café de olla, which comes with free refills.
